[
  "The case is classified as melanoma (MEL) for management guidance.",
  "The licensed guideline corpus contains recommendations for initial local management of melanoma.",
  "According to PMID 30392755 Table X, surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is also recommended for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "According to PMID 30392755 Table X, sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision whenever possible.",
  "According to PMID 39709737 Recommendation 1, when melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.",
  "The consensus rate for Recommendation 1 is 100% (21/21)."
]
